Interface Pilot

All Known Implementing Classes:
GyroDifferentialPilot, GyroRegulatedDifferentialDrive
public interface Pilot
Moves a robot straight and turns it in place, as leJOS's MoveController with its rotation does: the moves a Navigator drives a path with. travel(int) and rotate(int) block until the move ends and report whether it completed; a failure, a timeout or a stop() returns false rather than throwing, since the navigator runs them on a thread of its own.

Two kinds implement it: GyroRegulatedDifferentialDrive, whose wheels are regulated elsewhere (an RCX) and whose heading is corrected between moves, and GyroDifferentialPilot, which drives two encoder motors in a loop of its own and steers with the heading while it moves.

  • Method Details

    • travel

      boolean travel(int millimetres)
      Drives straight by millimetres, forward when positive, and waits until it ends. Returns true when the travel completed, false when it failed, timed out or was stopped; travelledMillimetres() then says how far it got.

    • rotate

      boolean rotate(int degrees)
      Turns in place by degrees, counter-clockwise when positive, and waits until it ends. Returns true when the turn completed, false when it failed, timed out or was stopped.

    • stop

      void stop()
      Asks the move in progress to end as soon as it can; safe to call from another thread.

    • travelledMillimetres

      int travelledMillimetres()
      The distance the last travel(int) covered, in millimetres, signed as it was asked, also when it ended early.

    • travelledLeftMillimetres

      int travelledLeftMillimetres()
      How far to the left of the line the last travel(int) started on it ended, in millimetres, as the pilot measured it, or UNMEASURED. travelledMillimetres() is then the distance along that line. A pilot that steers while it travels can weave, so its heading at the stop is one moment of the weave, not the leg's direction: a Navigator places the robot by this offset when the pilot measures it.

    • lastOutcome

      MoveOutcome lastOutcome()
      Why the last travel(int) or rotate(int) ended.
